title: Sonic Source Migration
observed_structure: a recurring sound begins with a stable visible source
the source later moves offscreen, into score, or into another object
the migration changes perceived agency or threat
cinematic_affordances: destroyed object leaves its sonic identity elsewhere
cultural_scope: film-sound theory; transferable across production cultures with local listening norms respected
misuse_risks: sound cue that explains the image
transferable_structure: a stable sound identity migrates between sources so agency and residue change without verbal explanation
non_transferable_surface: copying a famous film cue or culturally specific sonic marker without context
